title: Motorola Solutions Inc (MSI) Chairman and CEO Gregory Q Brown Sold $20.2 million of Shares
text:
2018-03-18 14:56:35 AAPL,BABA,FB,NFLX,P,SNAP,TWTR, 
In the last few weeks, we have seen two high profile unicorns file for initial public offerings. The first out of the gate was Dropbox (Pending:DBX), a storage solution for a world where gigabyte files are the rule rather than the exception, with a filing on February 23. Following close after, Motorola Solutions Inc (MSI) Chairman and CEO Gregory Q Brown Sold $20.2 million of Shares 
Chairman and CEO of Motorola Solutions Inc (NYSE:MSI) Gregory Q Brown sold 185,000 shares of MSI on 03/13/2018 at an average price of $109.08 a share. The total sale was $20.2 million. 
Motorola Solutions Inc is a communications equipment manufacturer. It provides communications infrastructure, devices such as two-way portable radios, and an array of communications network management and support services. Motorola Solutions Inc has a market cap of $17.57 billion; its shares were traded at around $108.95 with and P/S ratio of 2.87. The dividend yield of Motorola Solutions Inc stocks is 1.77%.
